notes.title: Rolling Arcade is Rolling in on June 10th.
notes.notes:
My new project is a smaller one compared to Exile Squadron, but not less fun. Rolling Arcade is a reimagined version of a classic mechanical arcade game, which you can just pick up and play anytime you have a few minutes of free time. 

Whether you are just waiting for a bigger game to download, or you just don't know what you want to play, you can fire up Rolling Arcade and beat a few levels, or your previous highscore. 

The good news is that the release of the game is just around the corner. Rolling Arcade will be available on the 10th of June, 2020.

If you don't want to miss out on the launch discount, put it in your wishlist and check back in 2 days.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1334330/Rolling_Arcade/

[previewyoutube=LZUwEad2U8M;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Exile Squadron Released on Linux
notes.notes:
It's been exactly 2 months since the release of Exile Squadron, so it is just fitting to celebrate this milestone with a big announcement.

I was always thinking about releasing the game for Linux, so more people can play it. Unfortunately I never had any experience with this operating system before, so I was a bit nervous to release anything on it. But today I can happily announce that the Linux version is ready, and anyone who is playing on this system can try it. 

I have tried to make it bug free, but if you notice anything strange, please report it. 

Have fun pilots!

notes.title: Patch 1.03 released
notes.notes:
The latest patch updates the game to version 1.03.

Fixes:
[list]
[*] decreased the damage output of the beam laser weapon,
[*] fixed the Level 5 Bonus Mission achievement, which failed to unlock upon completion.
[/list]

notes.title: Announcing the 1st Exile Squadron Championship
notes.notes:
Hi. I decided to run a small competition for Exile Squadron. The game features an online leaderboard, where your ingame scores are uploaded.

Winner: The Steam user who will be at the Number 1. position on the Steam Leaderboards at the end time of the Championship.

Competition ends: November 30, 2019, 4PM GMT.

PRIZE: A 25 EURO STEAM GIFT CARD, SENT THROUGH STEAM.

For a lucky gamer I created a Steam Giveaway, which you can check here:
https://www.steamgifts.com/giveaway/CdyIc/exile-squadron

Obviously anybody can participate. Good luck!

notes.title: Patch 1.02 released
notes.notes:
This patch brings up the game to version 1.02. 

Changes:
[list]
[*] Can't fire the beam laser weapon continuously anymore by rapidly pressing the primary attack button.
[*] Slightly decreased the overheat rate of the beam laser, and increased its damage.
[*] Upgrading a weapon automatically installs it on the ship.
[*] Attack drones cover a bigger area and move faster around the ship.
[*] Fixed a bug which caused units to have negative scores.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch: Hotfix version 1.01 released
notes.notes:
Why would the launch of a game go smoothly - asks every game developer ever?

I noticed a small error which resulted in some of the text not showing correctly in the Level Data menu. I released a quick fix, so after updating the game, you shouldn't encounter this error any more. 

I apologise for the inconvenience this caused.
